newsitem.title: USA: Angelica CEO resigns, interim CEO named.
newsitem.headline: Angelica CEO resigns, interim CEO named.

text.p: Angelica Corp said chairman, chief executive and president Lawrence Young resigned after a board review that the company said "concluded shareholder value can best be enhanced by strengthening our management."
Chairman emeritus Leslie Loewe was named chairman and interim president and CEO, said Angelica, which makes uniforms and provides textile rental and laundry services.
A search committee of the board has been appointed to recruit a new president and CEO, the company said.
Young agreed to remain with the company as president of its manufacturing and marketing segment and a board member.
Angelica shares closed Friday off 1/4 at 19.
